title: Recording: I Am Your Singer by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio One, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Tony Clark, Alan Parsons

The first overdub session for Wings’ Wild Life album took place on 29 July 1971.

Members of the Dolmetsch Family – Jeanne Dolmetsch, and Brian, Peter, Christine, and Paul Blood – were booked to play recorders on ‘I Am Your Singer’, the backing track for which had been recorded on 24 July. The musicians had worked with the McCartneys the previous month on the Thrillington album.

Paul McCartney explained what he wanted for the new song, and the session musicians wrote out their parts before recording took place.

Paul played what he wanted on the piano, and we, being classically trained musicians, wrote out our parts from what he played, and recorded the results. More experienced pop session musicians would probably have picked up what he wanted and played without music!
Brian Blood, 28 October 2016
The McCartney Legacy: Volume 1: 1969-73, Allan Kozinn, Adrian Sinclair
